name: Stitch
author: Erin Carter
description: Tiny glowing cross-stitches are planted one cell at a time by a bright needle glint working back and forth across a band of the frame. Each completed row carries a hashed folk-sampler motif tinted from one palette colour; the finished cloth drifts slowly up-frame and dims into the dark, like work receding into memory.

params.label: Sew speed
params.effect: Scales the needle's travel and stitch-planting rate, with the fabric scroll keeping pace; low is patient row-by-row needlework, high a brisk clatter of filling rows.

params.label: Stitch size
params.effect: Cell size of the cross-stitch grid in CSS px; small reads as fine dense tapestry bands, large as bold chunky folk stitches.

params.label: Lit rows
params.effect: How many completed rows stay lit above the needle before dimming away; few keeps a narrow luminous band in mostly dark cloth, many fills most of the frame with banded embroidery.

params.label: Sampler complexity
params.effect: Biases the hashed per-row band patterns; low keeps simple running stripes and zigzags, high works dense diamond, check, and bordered medallion samplers.
